sn56.3:1.1: Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānam kulaputtā sammāagārasmā anagāriyam pabbajiṃsu || sabbe te catunnam ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtam abhisamayāya || || 3.
sn56.3:1.2: Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave anāgatam addhānam kulaputtā sammāagārasmā anagāriyam pabbajjissanti || sabbe te catunnam ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtam abhisamayāya || || 4.
sn56.3:1.3: Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave etarahi kulaputtā sammāagārasmā anagāriyam pabbajjanti || sabbe te catunnam ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtam abhisamayāya ||
sn56.3:2.2: Dukkhassa ariyasaccassa || Dukkhasamudayassa ariyasaccassa || dukkhanirodhassa ariyasaccassa || dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasaccassa || || 6.
sn56.3:2.3: Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānaṃ kulaputtā sammāagārasmā anagāriyam pabbajiṃsu ||
sn56.3:2.5: pabbajanti || sabbe te imesaṃ yeva catunnam ariyasaccānam yathābhūtam abhisamayāya || ||
sn56.3:3.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhanti || pe || yogo karaṇīyo || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo
